## Change / 改动

Describe the resulting behavior and why it is needed. 说明行为变化及原因。

## Validation / 验证

List checks actually executed, including platform and profile coverage. 列出实际执行的检查及平台、配置范围。

## Compatibility / 兼容性

Describe any input/output, C ABI, compression or hardware behavior change. 说明输入输出、C ABI、压缩或设备行为的变化。
